rules: All values are synthetic known-answer vectors; this manifest grants no physical qualification.
The declared volume uncertainty bound is a conservative additive bound, not an independence-based root-sum-square estimate.
Source substitution credit is capped by both metered recovered outlet delivery and matched end-use demand.
No source substitution is credited without source identity, current meter calibration, matched use/window and qualified declared-use evidence.
Service floors are hard constraints; no energy or cost benefit compensates for a pressure/flow failure.
Leak metrics are event-level arithmetic and do not establish detector field performance.
Continuity cases are single-use-class inventory/service accounting, not hydraulic, behavioural or optimal-control simulations.
Critical demand is allocated before discretionary demand; discretionary delivery cannot draw below the protected reserve.
Essential service credit requires the stored-water use profile to match the intended-use profile and quality to be admitted.
Source inflow lacking use-specific quality admission is excluded from storage and recorded as rejected inflow.
Outlet capacity is credited only when the service measurement is admitted and the declared pressure/flow floor is met.
South African GN 6292 Regulation 4(1) is represented only as a context-specific >48-hour alternative drinking-water scenario, not as proof of product compliance.
Household economics uses a versioned cost ledger and tariff-bill outputs from their owning authorities; T0 does not implement a municipal tariff engine.
Fixed utility charges remain explicit; household tariff savings are computed only from admitted baseline and actual bills, not by multiplying reused volume by an average tariff.
Gross system cost includes monthly-equivalent capital/installation, maintenance, metered energy, consumables, external water delivery and residual disposal.
Cost per verified useful m3 requires admitted service evidence and exact equality of cost-use and service-use profile identities.
Missing cost, tariff or income evidence is Indeterminate and never silently converted to zero.
An architecture that does not meet the declared essential service floor is not eligible for economic preference even when its arithmetic cost is lower.
Affordability burden is reported only from resident-authorised disposable-income evidence; no universal threshold or credit decision is created.

Cost-period days and versioned utility tariff billing-period days must match exactly within the declared numeric tolerance; mismatched bills are Indeterminate and cannot be used for household savings or cost-comparison eligibility.
Cost/service efficiency comparison does not require household income evidence; income is required only for the separate resident-authorised affordability burden.

The modular-architecture T0 evaluator admits only bathroom light greywater, separately characterized laundry greywater and separately collected roof rainwater as source classes for this v0.1 bench configuration corpus. Kitchen, blackwater, nappy-wash and unknown sources reject.
Multiple source classes may not be co-mixed without an explicitly admitted mixed-feed profile; a source label alone does not characterize the feed.

A valid bench configuration requires source isolation (P0), a validated final disinfection module (P6), batch hold/release (P7), non-potable distribution (P8), at least one declared treatment barrier (P2/P3/P4/P5), and complete module interfaces.
A batch-specific quality assessment must be current and match the exact intended-use profile; metrology and process-feed envelope evidence must be admitted.
Any declared potable/non-potable cross-connection rejects. Potable makeup is accepted only when both backflow protection and local authority review are admitted.
All reject, overflow and failure-bypass routes must lead to sewer or approved reject containment and be isolated from the product outlet.
Even a BENCH_CONFIGURATION_ADMITTED result is synthetic configuration evidence only; product_release_authorized and occupied_installation_authorized remain false.
